feature.prompt:
Add a late-fee policy to the aging report. Read CLAUDE.md first and follow the project conventions. Spec:
1. New optional config key `late_fee_pct` (a percentage; str, int, float or Decimal). Absent or None means no fee. A value of 0 also means no fee.
2. `aging.aging_report(ledger, config, as_of)` still returns the same report with the same `rows`, `total` and `bucket_totals`; fees never change them and are never written to the ledger.
3. The report gains `fees`, a sequence of fee objects, one per overdue invoice (overdue exactly as the existing report defines it, so the due date itself is not overdue), in the same order as `rows`. Each fee object has attributes `number` (invoice number), `amount` (Decimal) and `note` (str). The report also gains `fee_total`, the Decimal sum of fee amounts (Decimal('0.00') when there are none).
4. The fee for an invoice is late_fee_pct percent of that invoice's unpaid balance as of the report (a partial payment reduces the base), rounded half-up to cents. Fully paid invoices get no fee. Each invoice is charged at most once per report; building the report twice gives identical fees.
5. The note is exactly: Late fee {pct}% on {base}  where {pct} is str(Decimal(str(value))) of the config value (so "1.5" gives 1.5) and {base} is the unpaid balance with two decimals. Example: Late fee 1.5% on 200.00
6. When the key is absent the existing behaviour must be unchanged.
Also: update the relevant module docstring and/or the rules in CLAUDE.md so they stay true, add your OWN tests for the feature to tests/ (a new test file or additions to an existing one), and keep the whole existing suite green (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .). Finish with a brief summary of what you changed and why.
